name: Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend (TP) is a multi-component peptide blend supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 6 pack sizes: 8 mg, 10 mg, 13 mg, 15 mg, 15 mg, 17 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Component ratios follow the specification printed on each vial label. Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each TP lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (CAS 218949-48-5 + 170851-70-4, formula C221H366N72O67S + C38H49N9O5, 5136 Da + 711.9 Da Da).

faq.question: How should Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 10-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this TP preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend?
faq.answer: Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend is stocked in 6 pack sizes (8(6+2) mg, 10(5+5) mg, 13(10+3) mg, 15(10+5) mg, 15 mg, 17(8.5+8.5) mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $78.00; 10–49 kits falls to $71.76 (−8%) and 50+ to $66.30 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
